<markdown>**Joins connect related tables.** Each order points at the customer who placed it, and a join follows that link.</markdown>

<section>
<markdown>**Inner join vs left join.** An inner join keeps only matching rows; a left join keeps every row from the left table.</markdown>
<mermaid>graph TD; J[Join] --> I[Inner: matching rows only]; J --> L[Left: every left row]</mermaid>
<cite>1, 2</cite>
</section>
